name: INDOLEM
description: Although the Indonesian language is spoken by almost 200 million people and the 10th mostspoken language in the world, 1 it is under-represented in NLP research. Previous work on Indonesian has been hampered by a lack of annotated datasets, a sparsity of language resources, and a lack of resource standardization. In this work, we release the INDOLEM dataset comprising seven tasks for the Indonesian language, spanning morpho-syntax, semantics, and discourse. We additionally release INDOBERT, a new pre-trained language model for Indonesian, and evaluate it over INDOLEM, in addition to benchmarking it against existing resources. Our experiments show that INDOBERT achieves state-of-the-art performance over most of the tasks in INDOLEM.
evaluation_method: task-dependent (F1 for sequence tasks like NER, accuracy for classification/parsing tasks)
general_score_metric: task-dependent (F1 / accuracy reported per task; micro-F1 commonly used for NER)
typical_sota_score: varies by task; many tasks in INDOLEM see SOTA models in the ~80–95% range depending on metric
notes: Language-specific benchmark for Indonesian with multiple small-to-moderate sized tasks; potential label imbalance and domain bias across tasks; not primarily an LLM benchmark.
